title: Player checks in for an event
description: At the check-in kiosk, a registered member chooses today’s event, enters their PIN, and joins attendance for the event.

steps.title: Event night at the kiosk
steps.body: Tutorial Event Night is open for check-in. Eden Brooks is already registered for the event.

steps.title: Find your name
steps.body: Type part of Eden Brooks in the name search so their row is easy to find.
steps.actionHint: Type in the name search field

steps.title: Start check-in
steps.body: Tap Check-in on your row. The kiosk asks for your score PIN and which admission to use.

steps.title: Choose the event
steps.body: Under Check-in type, select Tutorial Event Night. That records attendance for the event instead of a plain club visit.
steps.actionHint: Select the event in Check-in type

steps.title: Enter PIN and confirm
steps.body: Type your score PIN, then confirm Check-in. A correct PIN marks you Present for the event.
steps.actionHint: Click Check-in after entering the PIN

steps.title: Checked in for the event
steps.body: The row now offers Check-out. Event check-in is the fastest path for members who already registered.

steps.title: Paying for the event
steps.body: Members are responsible for approaching an Organizer or Admin to pay the event fee when required. Admins clear pending cash in Payment Log — see “Admin clears a cash payment.”
